finding: The current Python URLFlow has special preservation for source-backed no-argument strip and parsed-hostname rstrip(dot), but not whole-URL rstrip(slash). Its generic non-helper call clears url_checks. Lightning applies whole-URL rstrip(slash) after initial validation, before the direct fetch and well-known suffix routes. This is a source-visible guard-propagation barrier consistent with the observed unqualified finding. Concatenation also preserves checks only for fully restricted destinations; literal-only qualification need not meet that predicate.
